This is Joe Halliwell's website/blog. As you will have guessed, that's a picture of me above.

Posts appear when
they appear, on whatever seems interesting at the time but recurring interests
are Artificial Intelligence, Art and Language.

There is an [RSS feed](index.xml). There is also a list of [some things I have made](things.html)
which is atrophying at an alarming pace.
